steps.content: Hypatia wanders. She follows scattered motes of light through the shattered dreamscape, searching until—
Pleased to meet you, Ms. Hypatia. Allow me to introduce myself. I am Margaret Kervoz, the newly appointed DisCity Outland Affairs Officer.
A snow-white dove flits from the woman's shoulder to Hypatia's head. The bird rustles its wings, scattering a few loose feathers as it finds its perch.
Just another one, she tells herself, another stray shadow from the dream.
She turns to leave. However, a hand closes around her arm. The grip is startlingly solid, painfully real. It is the blonde woman.
This woman... she's not an illusion!
How did she get in here?! Is she trying to lead her out of this chaos?! But can she truly escape...

Before the questions can fully form, the woman's grip answers. It is firm, undeniable pressure. And then, with a tone that dissolves argument, the woman forcefully steps through the boundaries of her dreamscape.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: If you truly don't know which way to go, then listen to me, Hypatia.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Time is running out. Lingering in cycles of self-reproach will change nothing. If you genuinely wish to make a difference, then come with me.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I will show you the way, I will bear the responsibility, and I will fulfill what you seek. Because the "peace" I am building already encompasses all you desire.
